description: This file defines the MediaPlayer class in the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class provides an interface for media player operations, including initialization, destruction, and CAS data requests. It contains a deleted default constructor, a parameterized constructor, and virtual methods intended to be overridden. The class also holds a protected pointer to a UnifiedCASManagement instance.

classes.name: MediaPlayer
classes.description: A class representing a media player interface with methods for opening, closing, and requesting CAS data.

methods.description: Deleted default constructor preventing default instantiation.
